name: Endpoint information add-on v11
freeze_scope: These extension choices were recorded before executing the additional stress evaluations, after inspecting the original three-completion experiment; this is not preregistration.
selection: All eight original inputs, both original grids, both policies, both weight profiles and all three alpha values; no outcome-based exclusions.
original_methods: Preserve all 576 original selected plans and their original smooth-test values.
piecewise_linear: Optimize the single completion that linearly interpolates q_e between the endpoints available on the selected grid, using the original domain, workload scale, cap, profiles and preferences.
stress_choice: Fixed reciprocal powers, symmetric on a log scale around one; selected before viewing their outcomes, without tuning.
completion_formula: On each adjacent full-grid endpoint interval use q_lo-(q_lo-q_hi)*z**[p*(1+0.12*(leg_id%3-1))]. All methods are evaluated under the identical completion and same policy-specific oracle.
aggregation: Keep original smooth-three means/maxima separate from each additional stress power. Do not average all five as an empirical distribution.
least_favourable: For each grid separately, the common least-favourable endpoint completion gives J=upper_J; report it as a deterministic robust certificate, not an independent empirical win.
primary_outputs: Main 16-row method table for original smooth family; supplementary weights/routes with PL and separate stress table; matched grid changes and robust gaps.
limitations: Constructed memberships and completion families are not calibrated operational uncertainty.
A smooth completion family may favour point interpolation.
Repeated settings are descriptive and not independent replications.
No universal superiority of point interpolation or minimax is claimed.
